facts.fact: UNICEF Malawi reports that 10 districts have moved to a harmonised e-payment system and pay Social Cash Transfer Programme and Climate Smart Public Works beneficiaries through banks and mobile money operators, e.g. 14,378 in Ntcheu via FDH Bank and 10,070 in Balaka via mobile money.

systems.platform: bank accounts and mobile money wallets
systems.owner: Ministry of Gender, Community Development and Social Welfare
